meta.name: VoxTrap rule lexicon v1
meta.how_to_match: 1) normalize the transcript with the same rules as 'normalizer' below. 2) run every entry's 'regex' (Python re syntax) on the normalized text. 3) score = sum of weights per concept (positive concepts capped at +4, PROTECTIVE floored at -4). The same regex handles Roman, Urdu and mixed-script text, so no language detection is needed.

normalizer.urdu: strip diacritics, tatweel, zero-width chars; map ي/ى->ی, ك->ک, ه/ۃ->ہ, ؤ->و, أ/إ->ا; Arabic-Indic digits -> ASCII
normalizer.latin: o.t.p / o t p -> otp; c.n.i.c -> cnic; remove thousands commas; punctuation -> space

notes: Status DATA-BACKED = >=3 scam rows and (<=1 normal row for words/phrases, 0 for long patterns) in the training file.
LOW-SUPPORT = kept from domain knowledge; little or no support in the datasets.
PROTECTIVE entries have no training data; scammers can also say them, so cap their effect (floor -4).
Urdu forms are drafts: verify against real STT output (medium model).
